steps.content: [CG Background: Ceiling]
You wake up to the harsh glare of the ceiling lights and the faint smell of disinfectant.
The medical bay is quiet, save for the low hum of equipment and the distant sound of sea wind against the portholes, reminding you that you're back in reality.
A sudden coolness on your forehead brings you back to your senses. Someone is dabbing away your sweat with a towel, their touch slow and gentle.
Not yet used to the cabin's temperature, you turn your head stiffly to look at the person beside you.
[Shin's portrait]

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You're awake? I checked you over. Everything looks fine. You probably fainted due to psychological and mental stress.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: But I'm not a real ship doctor. It would be best to have someone more qualified examine you again once we're back on the land.
Your voice comes out hoarse. You've barely formed a syllable before she's smiling and holding a cup of water to your lips.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I know. <color=#fb9259>Forty degrees west by southwest</color>.
She carefully supports the back of your neck, helping you drink the warm water. Feeling a little embarrassed, you look away.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I can manage on my own.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I almost forgot. You did say you're an adult.
She chuckles softly and places the cup in your hand without fuss.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You were talking in your sleep. Your lips were chapped from the sea wind, but you just kept going. And you weren't just talking about land. What did you see... in your dream?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I saw...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It was huge, and very old... And it was sinking...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone was trying to escape, but it was too late...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It came from the bottom of the sea and quickly vanished...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But where it went, it left behind so many desperate cries for help.
You speak haltingly, your voice trailing off. Memories rush back like a tide, heavy enough to crush your chest.

Shin never interrupts you. She listens quietly until you've finished speaking, before picking up the towel again and gently dabbing the last traces of cold sweat from your brow. Then, she takes your hand and envelopes it in hers.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You've been through a lot.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: And you gave us the right direction.
Her voice is as warm as her hands, firm with an unswerving conviction.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The radar just came back online. Based on my earlier analysis of currents, pressure, and refraction... there is unusual terrain forty degrees west by southwest. The currents there are stable, with minimal temperature shifts. It's our best chance for survival.
Hearing her speak with such calm confidence, you quietly let out a sigh of relief and feel your nerves ease just a little.
Shin notices your tension. She leans in close, so her eyes are level with yours, and speaks in a quiet voice.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You held on until the very last moment. You remembered the direction. You even faced off... the corruption.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You're very brave.
This isn't the tone one uses to comfort a child. There's no exaggeration, no perfunctory praise. Every word is slow and earnest. She's showing you genuine acknowledgement.
You give her hand a gentle squeeze to let her know you're alright. In the gentle scent of disinfectant and sea breeze, the air feels peaceful and serene. But the next second...
The entire medical bay lurches.

The ceiling jolts, and the light swings violently. Medicine cabinets and equipment racks tumble to the floor with a deafening crash. The tremor comes from the bottom of the hull, as if something enormous just rammed into the vessel.
Shin springs to her feet, scanning the room with vigilant eyes before opening the medical bay door.
A fragmented broadcast crackles over the PA system. You hear Vikmar's terrified cry.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: S-something's wrong! In the wheelhouse... there's something in here...!
The broadcast breaks off abruptly, snapped by some invisible force. Only the jarring static echoes through every cabin.
Shin turns to look at you on the cot. You're conscious, but you haven't recovered enough strength to face this sudden crisis alone. She doesn't hesitate long.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Stay close to me. Can you do that?
[Scene Change]
Half-carrying, half-supporting you, Shin carefully guides you past the toppled shelves and shattered glass and through the lurching corridors.
This is more violent than before. The walls groan in agony with each shudder of the hull, the entire vessel straining against some unseen force that threatens to tear it apart.
Dark red emergency lights flash ahead, casting broken shadows across the cracked metal walls.
You stay close to Shin, relying on her strength to keep moving forward.
[Wheelhouse Entrance]
The captain and several crew members have already gathered outside the wheelhouse.
[Impact/Vibration]

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Vikmar! Can you open the door? Vikmar!!
The captain slams himself against the door, but it doesn't budge. A dark red fluid seeps through the panel, trickling down the seams and dripping onto the deck with a wet, sickening patter.
The door, corroded by the ooze and warped by force, has turned the wheelhouse into a chamber of despair.

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Cabin
steps.content: Land... there's land ahead...

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Cabin
steps.content: Only I... only I can get us there...

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: Aaaaaahhh! Don't come near me! Aaaahhh—!!!
Vikmar's terrible screams mix with the incessant pounding, drilling into everyone's ears and fraying their nerves.
Shin and you hurry over to the scene.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Where's the breaching axe?
The crew seems stunned. Shin asks again, her tone stern.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Where's the breaching axe?!

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Around the corner, by the stairs.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: I'll get it!
Reid quickly returns with the axe, but as he stands before the door, his hands begin to shake uncontrollably.
Forcing open the cabin door might release unknown contamination and threats from within.
What will he find inside? Vikmar's half-eaten corpse? Rotting things from DisSea? Or...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Break it down!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: <size=52><color=#fb9259>Save him!</size></color>
Shin's orders carry an unshakeable resolve. The axe comes down at her command, hitting the cabin door that separates them from the unknown horror.
One swing. Two. With the third strike, the lock shatters. The door teeters open.
The panel crashes to the floor. There's no one inside.
